|      | Can I cite in a table?[@rang2013] |      |

```{r}
tibble::tibble(a=1:3, b=c("a **bold** statement", "b[@rang2013]", "c"), c=c("1","2","3[@abousaud2020]"))|>
flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::footnote(i=1,j=1, value=flextable::as_paragraph("some text",flextable::as_sup("with bold")))|>
  ftExtra::colformat_md()
```

```{r}
require(flextable)
require(ftExtra)
require(tidyverse)
LicTab <- read_csv(here::here("data", "LicensesTable.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

LicTab |>
  filter(Detail != "Trial Citation") |>
  as_grouped_data(groups = "Setting") |>
  flextable(theme_fun = "booktabs") |>
  set_caption("Summary of licenses, NICE review and key trial outcomes for CDK4/6 inhibitors") |>
  width(width = c(1.5,2.5,4,4,4), unit="cm")|>
  merge_at(i=1, j=1:3) |>
  hline(i=2, j=2:5)|>
  merge_at(i=3, j=1:3) |>
  hline(i=6, j=2:5)|>
  merge_at(i=9, j=1:3) |>
    hline(i=8, j=2:5)|>
    hline(i=12, j=2:5)|>
  hline(i=14)|>
  merge_at(i=15, j=1:3) |>
    hline(i=16, j=2:5)|>
    hline(i=19, j=2:5)|>
  align(j=3:5, align = "center", part = "all") |>
  bold(j=1:2, bold = T, part ="body") |>
  ftExtra::colformat_md() |>
  footnote(j=c(3,4,5), i=2, value=as_paragraph("In pre- or perimenopausal women, the endocrine therapy should be combined with a LHRH", as_sup("*")," agonist"), part = "body", inline = T, sep ="; ", ref_symbols = "a") |>  # CHECK
  footnote(j="Detail", i=c(5,6,11,12,18,19), value=as_paragraph(as_b("HR"),": Hazard ratio (95% Confidence Interval)"), part = "body", inline = T, sep ="; ", ref_symbols = "b") |>
    footnote(j="Detail", i=c(7,13,20), value=as_paragraph(as_b("CDF"),": Cancer Drugs Fund - provides interim funding immediately following a positive draft NICE technology appraisal"), part = "body", inline = T, sep ="; ", ref_symbols = "c") |>
      footnote(j="Detail", i=c(8,14,21), value=as_paragraph(as_b("TA"),": Technology Appraisal (Date of final guidance)"), part = "body", inline = T, sep =". ", ref_symbols = "d") |>
  footnote(j="Detail", i=c(18,19), value=as_paragraph(as_b("IDFS"),": Invasive Disease Free Survival"), part = "body", inline = T, sep =". ", ref_symbols = "e") |>
  footnote(j="Ribociclib", i=c(16), value=as_paragraph("In pre- or perimenopausal women, or in men, the aromatase inhibitor  should be combined with a LHRH", as_sup("*") , " agonist"), part = "body", inline = T, sep =". ", ref_symbols = "f") |>
    footnote(j=c(3:5,3,5), i=c(2,2,2,16,16), value=as_paragraph(as_b("HR-positive"),": Hormone Receptor positive; ", as_b("HER2"),": Human Epidermal Growth factor Receptor-2; ", as_b("LHRH"),": Luteinizing Hormone‑Releasing Hormone."), part = "body", inline = F, sep =". ", ref_symbols = "*") |>
  footnote(j=3:5, i=2, value=as_paragraph(as_i(as_b("ns")),": not statistically significant by study design"), part = "body", inline = F, sep =".", ref_symbols = " ") |>
    font (fontname = "Arial Narrow", part="all") |>
  fontsize(size=6.5, part = "all") -> ft

ft
  


```
